scope.architecture: manual seed -> relative motion estimator -> map marker

primarySupportCorrection.selection: fixed before M1.2 outcome scoring; no annulus sweep or per-control tuning

staticHeldComposite.template: per-pixel temporal mean of all 40 deterministic real-fixture work-feature fields
staticHeldComposite.residual: selected frame work-feature field minus that fixed template
staticHeldComposite.support: same preregistered fixed dynamic annulus used by the estimator

motionEvidence.validMotion: nonzero candidate, texture sufficient, bounded dt-aware search, and peakAdvantage >= 0.05
motionEvidence.noMotion: zero-displacement candidate within 0.05 work px with stable zero-hypothesis evidence; integrates zero and advances reference
motionEvidence.unreliable: otherwise; does not move marker, advances reference deliberately, increments lostMotionIntervals, and reports degraded tracking

captureCadenceContract.clock: fixed-rate setInterval started independently of processing completion
captureCadenceContract.queue: at most one freshest pending frame; replacement drops obsolete pending frame

dtAwareSearch.rationale: nominal radius 8 covers the observed 1-2 work-px real pairs with bounded cost; scaling is capped by the previously measured 19.5 work-px pure-translation capability

rejectionStateSemantics.unreliable: advance reference, increment explicit lostMotionIntervals, preserve marker position, report degraded status
forbidden: indefinitely holding an old previous frame

calibrationPolicy.m1_2Action: ignore and remove the legacy persisted value on initialization; use fixed relative scale 1.0
calibrationPolicy.twoAnchorControl: hidden and disabled; no owner-facing calibration action
calibrationPolicy.syntheticTests: must not persist inferred physical scale or claim physical meters/map scale

verdictDefinitions.M1.2-AUTO-PASS: all frozen estimator, stride, scheduler, safety, calibration-disabled, absolute-disabled, and old-M1 regression gates pass
verdictDefinitions.M1.2-PARTIAL: primary defect materially improves but one or more frozen required gates remain unresolved
verdictDefinitions.M1.2-FAIL: fixed dynamic annulus fails the primary fidelity gate; stop without post-hoc matcher/support changes
